segments.text: Rain beads on the quiet house.
The back door and floor show ordinary signs of a hurried departure.
Michelle's phone holds a drained battery and no immediate answer.
The damaged voice recording on Michelle's memory card crackles with a warning not to trust emergency broadcasts.
A patrol vehicle approaches the front gate and begins searching the property.
The house evidence points toward a concrete local lead.
The invalid probe leaves the local evidence unchanged.
